notes: The waw takes the postpositive even (rules 14, 51); distance from the waw is not evidence against it, and the unit is discontinuous under rule 25.
עָשׂוֹ יַעֲשֶׂה is split under rule 56: surely to the infinitive absolute, he shall deal to the finite cognate verb.
בְּיַד is split rather than fused, the ASV spending into on the preposition and the hand on the construct noun (rule 30's subtraction test).
